# Glitz & Glamour Studio

> Premium nail, hair, and beauty salon in Vista and San Marcos, CA — led by JoJany Lavalle.

## About
Glitz & Glamour Studio is a premier full-service beauty salon located in North County San Diego (San Marcos / Vista, CA). We specialize in luxury nail art (Gel-X, acrylic full sets, dip powder, structured Russian manicures), professional hair styling (balayage, blonding, precision cuts, color correction, blowouts), full-body waxing (Brazilian, eyebrow shaping), customized medical-grade facials, and lash extensions.

- Phone: [+1 (760) 290-5910](tel:+17602905910)
- Email: [info@glitzandglamours.com](mailto:info@glitzandglamours.com)
- Instagram: [@glitzandglamourstudio](https://www.instagram.com/glitzandglamourstudio/)
- Physical Address: [935 W San Marcos Blvd, Suite 101, San Marcos, CA 92078](https://maps.google.com/?q=935+W+San+Marcos+Blvd+Suite+101+San+Marcos+CA+92078)

## Service Categories
- [Nail Services](https://glitzandglamours.com/services#nails): Acrylic full sets, Gel-X extensions, dip powder, structured gel manicures, custom freestyle nail art, and nail repair.
- [Hair Care & Color](https://glitzandglamours.com/services#haircolor): Balayage, highlights, full color, precision cuts, blowout styling, and deep conditioning treatments.
- [Waxing Services](https://glitzandglamours.com/services#waxing): Eyebrow shaping, lip, chin, Brazilian, bikini, underarm, arm, and full leg waxing.
- [Facials & Skincare](https://glitzandglamours.com/services#facials): Deep cleansing, blackhead extraction, hydrating facials, and anti-aging treatments.
- [Lash & Brow Enhancements](https://glitzandglamours.com/services#lashes): Classic, hybrid, and volume lash extensions, lash lifts, and tinting.
- [Pedicures & Spa Care](https://glitzandglamours.com/services#pedicures): Classic pedicures, deluxe spa treatments, and jelly hydrating foot detox.

## Operating Hours & Location
- Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed
- Service Area: San Marcos, Vista, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Escondido, and surrounding North County San Diego areas.
